environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT (not block), (2) A custom rule with priority 1 that uses a RegexPatternSet matching on query string parameters - the pattern set contains entries for common UNION/SELECT patterns but uses a regex that only matches uppercase variants (UNION\s+SELECT), (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode. The task runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) and the database is mounted from an EFS volume at /data. The ECS task role has no additional permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch logs. Container runs as non-root uid 1000.
